== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100673 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100673], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100673-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>cdcc5ef55bc629a51da65f69b5f1180fc4f253ded54df168a767e92221a29424</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
